semantic_checks: The literal 2140-slot table relocates the three actual child programs with paid returns and invokes the complete empty-demand scan before any avoiding query. Thus a later infeasible occurrence takes priority over an earlier positive path.

The saved original demand/context record survives the empty scan. Its actual absence root enters the avoiding scan on the same append-only heap; a returned witness is tagged using its original occurrence and path roots.
Total avoiding absence restores the original cost-row pointer, calls the real numerator-zero mask constructor and tags its returned root. No decision, path or mask output is supplied.

The three real tag allocations encode exactly the original dispatch result: false for infeasible, true for zero mask, nil for positive demand/path. The theorem identifies the first component of the old result only.

The independent inputSteps envelope sums original input scan bounds and zero-row bit/count bounds, covering all branch overhead. The physical theorem retains the same run, original table/context/source, empty stack, final pc2139 and terminal attempt charge.
Thirteen separately checked physical cases bind first/late and duplicate occurrence pointers, directed absent paths, padded labels, zero/positive interior paths and global infeasibility priority.
